name: Kor Jiramma; (The Bootana Hutta region, with Kor Jiramma represented by the number 17)
description: Kor Jiramma was a world located in the Kor Jiramma system, a part of the Bootana Hutta area in the Hutt Space portion of the Slice. A hyperlane linked it to the Huloon system. Kor Jiramma was the throneworld of the Jiramma clan of the Hutt species, and its proximity to the throneworld Kor Vanderijar was a reason for partnership between the Jiramma and the Vanderijar clan.
